jsonld.description: Sheraton Suites Columbus Worthington sets the bar higher with its stylish stature and polished but casual service. Not far from the ample shopping, dining, and entertainment options of the Polaris Fashion Mall area, this full-service all-suites hotel offers on-site dining, Starbucks, indoor and outdoor pools, and a nicely equipped 24-hour fitness center. Close to top attractions such as the Columbus Zoo and Zoombezi Bay; The Ohio State University, Ohio Stadium, and Columbus Convention Center are easy drives. Situated off the I-270 outer belt, we are convenient to Columbus International Airport (CMH). Each sizable suite features modern touches such as a barn door separating the sleeping and sitting rooms and glass-enclosed showers. Suites feature Sheraton Signature Beds, two TVs, a safe, and a mini-fridge. Sophisticated event spaces are ideal for meetings, weddings, corporate and social events, complete with exceptional food and beverage service. We look forward to anticipating your every expectation soon.
